sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt:

interim dividend of $0.01 per Ordinary Share. The dividend was paid out on July 31, 2023, to the shareholders whose names are on the record
at the close of business on July 3, 2023. On July 31, 2023, we paid out dividends in the amount of $104,557.28 to our shareholders. Dividends will be paid to shareholders on
